newsitem.title: CHINA: China bans industrial firms from trading stocks.
newsitem.headline: China bans industrial firms from trading stocks.

text.p: China's central bank has issued new rules banning industrial firms and finance companies set up by industrial groups from trading stocks and futures, the Business News said on Friday.
The People's Bank of China in the set of rules "bans any financial firms under industrial enterprises from trading stocks and (commodity) futures in China", the newspaper said.
The newspaper made no mention of what the firms should do if they needed to hedge their commodity requirements on the futures markets.

The rules said financial firms set up by industrial groups may only conduct credit, lending, broking and settlement business internally among different members of the group, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
